primer: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF (NASDAQ: MSTX) is a daily-reset 2x leveraged single-stock ETF tracking Strategy Inc. (MSTR) via total return swaps. While it executes its single-day 200% mandate for intraday traders, its 1.31% unitary fee, OBFR+10%–17% swap financing spreads, non-deferrable RIC distributions, and mathematical volatility decay produced a -90.60% 1-year return and a 1-for-10 reverse split in March 2026. Rated FUNDAMENTAL_FAIL and trading in Weinstein Stage 4 at $8.75, MSTX is REJECTED for new capital.
